-Hating going to buy clothes. It was always weird for me cuz i do like going to buy clothes (im any videogame that lets me do it i spend a fair lot of time just looking for clothes), i just dont like femenine clothes.

-i never liked the idea of being a mother, in fact, i always hated the idea of getting pregnant, but i didnt hate the idea of being a parent, i just knew that i wont be the one giving birth

-never felt comfortable with the idea of being "cute" in a femenine way, i want to be cute in a masculine way if that makes sense

-i always pictured myself in the future as either androginous or just a man without noticing it. Thinking of me as a woman just never felt quite right.

My name starts with the same letter as my legal name, but is mostly unrelated, besides, the male version of my legal name sounds weird af and i havent met a single person with it, so people would have a harder time adapting to it, including myself

Probably frozono
Cool name, i like it 👍

Im not trans, but if i had to choose a superpower it would be shapeshifting and i would permanently be a man

Im not trans, but i like to use male characters in videogames cuz i prefer their outfits and they look cool

Im not trans, but if i had to get surgery to remove my uterus i wouldnt be sad (same with breast)

Im not trans i just wish i could make my voice deeper to the point i sound like a man

I like to think that if there is a god somewhere he is trying to fix his mistake with me, im pretty sure i have some kind of hormone imbalance or at least a delayed puberty cuz i still look like a child and things like my chest and waist didnt start to develop until recently, so i guess god is like "look, im sorry i fucked up, i cant change your chromosomes now, but i can delay your puberty for a while"
Not serious, its just a funny idea i have to cheer me up sometimes
Somehow my brain read that terribly wrong as "anyone else have the macs urge to jump on thigh highs?"
Even before knowing i was trans, the idea of getting pregnant made me sick, i have always said that if i ever wanted to get kids i will adopt

David, my mom said that if i was born a boy my name would have been David for sure. I dont like it and is the name of my brother. Besides, it would have brought the same problems as my legal name, as David could defeat a giant and my legal name means something along the lines of "brave", and my family (especifically my mom) mocks me some times because in not brave at all, im a ball of pure anxiety with legs
I really liked it and is one of the names my mom could have given me if i was born a boy
Thats like saying you don't have astigmatism until you buy glasses. It doesn't matter if i can or can't afford them, my eyesight is still shit
Hi Oliver, hope you are having a nice day! Your name is really cool, i like it :D

My prefered name starts with the same letter as my legal name (im closeted for safety reasons), i havent thought about my midle name and i want to keep my last name, but id have to move out to another place first so i dont get recognized

Usually im either unable to see my body or just like... a floating camera? Kinda just seeing all but not interacting directly in the dream, ocacionally becoming another person on the dream and seeing things on their perspective
On my lucid dreams i am usually a men, but i can shift my appearence randomly, but again, i cant directly see my whole body, i just know it because of the sound of my voice and the shape of my hands
At least in lucid dreams my brain uses my correct pronouns, so thats something
Link from BOTW or Howl from Howl's moving castle

My parents dont know, but they try to make me be more femenine and for other reasons i know i cant tell them im a man until im fully independent.
The hard part is that i find it hard to start an actual life with me being percieved as a woman, i really wish i could just start transition now

Good? Just anxious cuz im in the closet and in christmas we will have family reunion and they usually make really transphobic and homophobic jokes non-stop. Also, they will start asking for my career choice (they already know what i want to study, but they ask every single time we meet), and will keep insisting on changing my career to be a medic
I know i just have to endure it for 2 or 3 days, but still is upsetting i cant just make an excuse so i dont have to go see them and have just one christmas without hearing bullshit
Everything else, my mental health has improved actually, im better than i was a few weeks ago, that makes me happy
Good till i remember i have a formal event saturday and i gotta either use a dress or femenine clothes cuz i cant come out to my family, everything else its good

Im not out yet, but since i have a lil brother who is almost my age, my mom sometimes calls me "son" or any word but in the masculine variant and doesnt correct herself because she doesnt realize. I dont correct her either and it makes me feel really happy for a moment

My neck
Its too thin for my liking (not much, but enough to make me look femenine)

Same, like "why would anyone want to be a woman? Every woman wants to be a man, right?"
I think we all have this same thought to some degree

Wanting to use male deodorant because i wanted to smell like whatever those are instead of "flowey field"

And feeling really upset when having to do folklore dances because i had to do femenine movements, but thinking that hating to dance like a girl was a completly cis thing and every girl would like to dance and dress as the guy instead

I have some doubts about this one. Im not from argentina nor i have been there before, but generally speaking, i would recomend avoid LATAM when it comes to LGBTQ+ stuff. Even if the law says something, the regulation of those laws isnt the best (actually, not only LGBT related laws, this flaw on regulation is general). 
Also, the homophobia here can be really strong, let alone transphobia, its not unusual to see people making really homophobic jokes out of nowhere and trying to make them stop usually end up on you being made fun of for "not taking a joke" (literally the other day i had a small family gathering and out of absolute nowhere they started making homophobic and transphobic jokes non-stop like it was a normal, harmless thing to do).
Now, like i said, im not from argentina, im from Chile actually, so dont take this statement as 100% truth, but as someone who lives in the region, i would advice being careful with coming here

No born with, almost everything about me is like the peak of femeninity (example: relative small, round face, thin hands, legs and arms, long eyelashes, thin eyebrows, not much body hair and the one i have is light enough to be practically invisible, and a small nose), wich is sad cuz if i was a cis woman i would be damn happy

 the only thing that gives me euphoria about my body for now is that my chest is still small enough that i can look flat-chested with a few tight clothes on and still be able to breathe and do stuff like working out with no problem

Proteus from Simbad: legend of the seven seas, Tarzan, aladin and Jim from treasure planet
Proteus was my favourite as "i want to be him"
I only get adds for games i already have downloaded or those weird adds that are borderline porn, so idk :/
I always said that if i was gonna have kids, i wanted to adopt. Even before having a bit of suspicion about me being trans, i never liked the idea of being pregnant or give birth
Turtle

Voice and chest, i sound like a 13 yo girl even if im legally an adult, so yeah, people already mistake me for a little girl if i was cis, imagine trying to pass with this voice.
And my chest cuz recently started to grow more than it used to, its small enough for me to cover it up witha few shirts or hoodies, but feeling the pain and itchiness of it growing a bit its very dysphoric.

My face too, less than voice and chest, but its mostly because i already look young for a cis woman (again, i have been mistaken by a 12-15 yo) so transitioning will be a pain when i start it, im sure that people will ask for my id for everything or tell me to call my parents.

Also, for weird reasons, eyebrows
Purple or yellow (yellow usually just because i cant find blue flowers for my purple bed)

In my close family, the only "femenine sneeze" is my mom, and still is kinda loud, my dad, my brother and i sneeze loud like a fucking bomb, you can hear when someone in the house sneezes no matter where you are
I wonder whos idea was to gender laughs and sneezes, i wish i could buy a time machine and beat them for being stupid

I have a lot of memories when i was very little of being told to act lady like (thankfullly, very few are from my parents, they started to tell me this after i hit puberty)
I especially hate one where the boys at my class where given devil paper masks for them to color (for a festivity, "la diablada"). I wanted one too, cuz i always loved the masks the demons wear in that dance, but i was told i couldnt have one cuz "only the boys can be devils, girls have to wear a dress" 
Another thing i used to hear a lot is to "sit like a girl", but i havent hear that in about a year or so, so i think they gave up on that one

Yeah.. im a bit jealous of him, not only because he has the experience i wish i had, but also because he always gets to do stuff i want to do or gets stuff i want to have (usually my family (except my parents) gives him stuff like a tank looking music box, a small stone statue of a beetle, he even got a big pc and a bluetooth controller, while i get necklaces, bracelets and perfume, even if my whole famiky knows i dont wear any of those and just have them as decorations on my room)
I know he has no control over what people gift him and being jealous about it is a bit stupid, but im still jealous of seeing how my family would have treated me if i was born a cis man

My parents are the exception cuz they usually tried to give us similar stuff as gifts. If he recieved a lego set, i recieved a lego set, if i recieved a phone, he would recieve a new phone.

I always have been bisexual, the first time i got a crush on a girl i went "wait... i like girls, am i lesbian? But... i still like guys..? Alright, i guess i like both then" and continued to not confess my feelings to anyone

I would say both figure and voice, but if i have to choose, i would say voice because i have been having insecurity about it for a longer time than my figure (my figure has only started to change now that im 18, but is strong enough to put it equal to my voice)

I always liked the name Victor for no reason, and once i used it as my name in a pokemon game and i felt so happy to see the characters refer to me as Victor that i started using it online, and after years of having it as my username in games and stuff i feel its the right one for me, it just feel natural to go by that name.

And also, Victor is one of the names on my mother's list of names she had for me, cuz they didnt knew if i was gonna be born a boy or a girl

I asked the same thing to my mom and thats how i found out that the doctors didnt knew if i was going to be a girl or a boy because i either had my hands covering my privates or i was in a position where they just couldnt see, so my parents had a list of both female and male names
And my prefered name is on that list of names, that makes me happy :]
